item.name: /login
Setup

request.description: Creates a new admin user with random credentials. Saves the generated email and password to environment variables for use in subsequent login requests.

item.description: Pre-test setup for the login flow. Creates a user with random credentials and saves the email and password to environment variables for use in subsequent login requests.

request.description: Attempts to log in using valid credentials previously stored in environment variables. Expects a 200 response and saves the authorization token to the environment.
Attempts to log in using random invalid credentials. Expects a 401 Unauthorized response with an appropriate error message.
Attempts to log in with empty email and password fields. Expects a 400 Bad Request response with field-level validation error messages.

item.description: Contains all test scenarios for the login endpoint (`/login`). Covers successful authentication, invalid credentials, and empty field validation.
